newsitem.title: USA: Rumors Michael Jackson's wife giving birth in LA.
newsitem.headline: Rumors Michael Jackson's wife giving birth in LA.

text.p: Reporters and camera crews staked out a Beverly Hills hospital on Wednesday amid speculation that pop singer Michael Jackson's wife was about to give birth.
Local television stations cited sources as saying Debbie Rowe was in a room on the third floor of the famed Cedars-Sinai Medical Centre and that doctors had induced labour.
Security was tight and a spokeswoman for the hospital said she knew nothing about whether Jackson's wife or the singer himself were there.
There was no immediate comment from Jackson's publicists.
Local KABC television said several sources had told the station that Rowe, 37, checked into Cedars-Sinai on Tuesday night and that Wednesday was her due date.
Recent reports said Rowe, who married Jackson on Nov. 15 in Australia less than a year after his divorce from Lisa Marie Presley, would give birth at a clinic in Switzerland.
The couple have known each other for several years, as Rowe had worked in the Beverly Hills office of Jackson's dermatologist.
Cedars-Sinai has been in the media focus recently, following the birth there last year of Madonna's daughter, Lourdes, and last month's stay by Frank Sinatra, after he suffered a heart attack.
